query: Signatures and usage: decodeFile, decode, eitherDecode, encode, FromJSON and ToJSON class definitions, genericParseJSON and genericToJSON, how to hand-write a FromJSON instance with genericParseJSON and a ToJSON instance with genericToJSON, and the Value/KeyObject types. Also which module re-exports these (Data.Aeson).
answer: From the content: `Data.Aeson` re-exports `decode`, `eitherDecode`, `encode` (`encode :: (ToJSON a) => a -> L.ByteString`), the `FromJSON` and `ToJSON` classes, `genericParseJSON` and `genericToJSON`, and `Value`/`Object`/`Key`. `FromJSON a` has `parseJSON :: Value -> Parser a` (default `genericParseJSON defaultOptions`); `ToJSON a` has `toJSON :: a -> Value` (default `genericToJSON defaultOptions`) and `toEncoding :: a -> Encoding` (use `genericToEncoding defaultOptions`). `genericParseJSON :: (Generic a, GFromJSON Zero (Rep a)) => Options -> Value -> Parser a` and `genericToJSON :: (Generic a, GToJSON' Value Zero (Rep a)) => Options -> a -> Value`. So a hand-written generic instance is `instance FromJSON T where parseJSON = genericParseJSON defaultOptions` / `instance ToJSON T where toJSON = genericToJSON defaultOptions` (or `toEncoding = genericToEncoding defaultOptions`). `Value` is `data Value = Object !Object | Array !Array | String !Text | Number !Scientific | Bool !Bool | Null`. Not covered: the signature of `decodeFile`, and a `KeyObject` type (no such name appears; the object type is `Object`).

-- src/Data/Aeson/Types/FromJSON.hs
class FromJSON a where
    parseJSON :: Value -> Parser a

    default parseJSON :: (Generic a, GFromJSON Zero (Rep a)) => Value -> Parser a
    parseJSON = genericParseJSON defaultOptions

    parseJSONList :: Value -> Parser [a]
    parseJSONList = withArray "[]" $ \a ->
          zipWithM (parseIndexedJSON parseJSON) [0..]
        . V.toList
        $ a

    -- | Default value for optional fields.
    -- Used by @('.:?=')@ operator, and Generics and TH deriving
    -- with @'allowOmittedFields' = True@ (default).
    --
    -- @since 2.2.0.0
    omittedField :: Maybe a
    omittedField = Nothing

-- | @since 2.1.0.0

-- src/Data/Aeson/Types/ToJSON.hs
class ToJSON a where
    -- | Convert a Haskell value to a JSON-friendly intermediate type.
    toJSON     :: a -> Value

    default toJSON :: (Generic a, GToJSON' Value Zero (Rep a)) => a -> Value
    toJSON = genericToJSON defaultOptions

    -- | Encode a Haskell value as JSON.
    --
    -- The default implementation of this method creates an
    -- intermediate 'Value' using 'toJSON'.  This provides
    -- source-level compatibility for people upgrading from older
    -- versions of this library, but obviously offers no performance
    -- advantage.
    --
    -- To benefit from direct encoding, you /must/ provide an
    -- implementation for this method.  The easiest way to do so is by
    -- having your types implement 'Generic' using the @DeriveGeneric@
    -- extension, and then have GHC generate a method body as follows.
    --
    -- @
    -- instance 'ToJSON' Coord where
    --     'toEncoding' = 'genericToEncoding' 'defaultOptions'
    -- @
    toEncoding :: a -> Encoding
    toEncoding = E.value . toJSON

    toJSONList :: [a] -> Value
    toJSONList = listValue toJSON

    toEncodingList :: [a] -> Encoding
    toEncodingList = listEncoding toEncoding
